faq: Do you supply steel buildings in Star Valley?
Yes. We are based in Evanston, Wyoming, and supply buildings throughout Star Valley, including Afton, Alpine, Thayne, Etna, and Freedom.
Can your buildings handle Star Valley snow and wind?
We engineer every building for your site’s snow and wind loads. Design loads vary by location and elevation, so tell us your project location.
Do I need a permit for a steel building in Star Valley?
Yes, in most places. Requirements vary by town and county. Check with your local building department. Your building is engineered for local codes, with plans prepared for permitting.
How long does it take to get a steel building in Star Valley?
Our current turnaround is 8 to 10 weeks. Timelines can vary with project size, options, and demand. Your building package is then delivered to your job site.
Yes. Many owners build their own buildings or hire a local contractor. Your building package is prepared for accurate, efficient assembly.
Do you supply overhead doors and windows?
No. We design the building and its openings for the overhead doors and windows you choose, and they are installed by others. We supply commercial walk doors (man doors).
What kinds of buildings do you supply?
Shops and garages, agricultural and ranch buildings, barndominiums, storage buildings, commercial and industrial buildings, aircraft hangars, and more.
Our office is at 254 City View Dr., Evanston, WY 82930. We supply buildings throughout Star Valley and Wyoming.
